name: read-then-assert-expr
description: read fetches an attribute field and a state field into variables, and a later assertExpr step consumes both
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: read then assert
env: {}
---
- launchApp
- read:
    selector:
      id: qty_field
    field: value
    as: qty
- read:
    selector:
      id: terms_checkbox
    field: checked
    as: accepted
- assertExpr:
    expr: "qty == \"5\" and accepted == true"
